They are in an outdoor setting under a wooden-beamed roof with greenery in the background. (2) The scene shifts to the woman in the white shirt walking outdoors, looking back at the camera; a man wearing a black cap and a white t-shirt with a backpack walks behind her. (3) The woman in the white shirt stands under a thatched-roof structure, talking to the camera and touching her neck nervously; she wears an Apple Watch on her left wrist. (4) She is then seen crouching and hiding behind a wall made of large grey river stones, peeking over the top toward an open area where a red basin and a large wooden mortar and pestle are visible on the ground. (5) The camera follows her as she walks out from hiding toward a group of people gathered in a clearing; a man in a black t-shirt and glasses stands on a small stage-like area holding a large yellow donation board. (6) A close-up shows the man smiling and holding the donation board which displays the amount '$112,990'; he gestures with his hands in a playful manner. (7) The woman in the white shirt joins the man and another woman, talking and laughing; the man holds a large brown envelope. (8) The video concludes with a group photo of the creator, the man, and the woman in the red vest, all giving thumbs-up and smiling while holding the donation board.
